description: This file defines the 'Constraint' class in the Drupal Component Version namespace, representing Drupal version constraints with parsing and compatibility checking functionalities.

classes.name: Constraint
classes.description: A value object representing a Drupal version constraint, capable of parsing constraint strings and checking version compatibility.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the Constraint object with a constraint string and core compatibility, parsing the constraint.

methods.name: __toString
methods.description: Returns the constraint as a string for reporting or UI purposes.

methods.name: isCompatible
methods.description: Checks if a given version satisfies the constraint.

methods.name: parseConstraint
methods.description: Parses a constraint string into an internal array of operations and versions.
